将原图进行高清画质修复与清晰度增强，仅提升画面质量，不改变画面风格、人物风格及整体视觉效果。严格保持原始画面内容、主体姿态、人物身份、五官特征、服装款式、构图、背景环境、光影关系和色彩氛围不变，不新增、不删减、不替换任何物体或细节，也不进行风格化重绘。

仅对画面进行高质量修复与细节还原，重点改善分辨率与清晰度，增强皮肤质感、发丝边缘、布料纹理和环境细节，同时去除噪点、模糊、压缩痕迹、网格感、脏污色块及轻微瑕疵，使画面更加干净、自然、清晰，但整体风格、人物风格和原始观感保持不变。

优化修改这张图，物理现实主义是最高优先级。将图像转变成真正的专业照片。自动删除所有 AI 伪影、CGI 外观、渲染痕迹、合成纹理、不切实际的照明、扭曲的解剖结构、扭曲的几何形状、重复的图案、浮动的主题和人工完美。根据现实世界的物理原理重建照明、阴影、反射、材质、透视和环境交互。保留原始构图、主题、产品设计、比例和场景结构。增强自然皮肤纹理、织物细节、材料真实感、微观缺陷和真实的相机光学。最终结果必须与真实的商业照片没有区别，优先考虑现实主义、物理准确性和摄影真实性而不是风格化。

early 2010s snapshot photo captured with a phone and uploaded to facebook, featuring dynamic natural lighting, and a neutral white color balance with washed out colors,asian girl,28-old-years,, The image showcases a cozy, well-organized living or study space with a centerpiece white storage cabinet. The cabinet stands tall, featuring two sections. The upper section has double glass-paneled doors with golden knobs, revealing shelves filled with books, decorative items, neatly stacked boxes, a pot with colorful flowers, and a plush teddy bear. The lower section has solid white doors with matching golden knobs, adding a clean and tidy look by concealing additional storage.

The background is a soft beige wall with a delicate black stripe running horizontally across, giving the room a balanced tone. A framed piece of abstract artwork hangs on the wall to the left of the cabinet, adding visual interest. Below the artwork, a tall and elegant black floor lamp with a classic beige lampshade stands out, casting a soft light and shadow on the wall.

Natural light pours in from a large window with white sheer curtains on the right, creating an inviting ambiance. The room's floor is wooden with a textured beige and brown striped rug partially visible in the foreground. The overall setting feels warm, serene, and thoughtfully arranged, blending functionality with aesthetic appeal.
